system.description:
Usage scattered upon a surface; Weight 1 lb. Activate 3 AP.

The grains are mixed with silver dust and fragments of funerary prayer written on paper thin enough to crumble between the fingers.

Scatter a packet across a 10-foot line or around one 5-foot square. The salt remains active for 10 minutes. A disembodied spirit or incorporeal Undead attempting to cross the salt must attempt a Will saving throw against the item's Level DC.

Corporeal creatures, including Unliving characters, can cross normally. Disturbing or washing away the salt destroys the ward.

Critical: It crosses normally.

Success: It crosses but becomes Weakened 1 until the end of its next turn.

Failure: It cannot cross until the beginning of its next turn.

Fumble: It cannot voluntarily cross the salt for 1 minute.

On the sheet: used, the card prints the ward and its ladder; the spirit's save is rolled from the card against the item's Level DC.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 11.

effects.text: Scattered across a 10-foot line or around one 5-foot square, active for 10 minutes: a disembodied spirit or incorporeal Undead crossing it makes a Will save against DC (the item's Level DC, level 6) — Critical: crosses; Success: crosses, Weakened 1 until the end of its next turn; Failure: cannot cross until the beginning of its next turn; Fumble: cannot voluntarily cross for 1 minute. Corporeal creatures cross freely; disturbing the salt ends it.
